claims.sentence: You can get academic leave if you are a student or postgraduate enrolled in the University’s main professional educational programs
The leave is granted when you are temporarily unable to study for the following reasons
Conscription into military service or signing a contract for military service
Medical indications
Other exceptional cases, including natural disasters or family circumstances
The standard duration of academic leave is up to 12 calendar months at one time
However, if the leave is for military service or medical reasons, the period can be up to two years
You can take academic leave an unlimited number of times during your studies
The total period of leave cannot exceed two years
To apply, you must submit a personal application to the University Director
The application form is specified in Appendix 1 to the Regulation
You must also provide supporting documents depending on your reason for leave
For medical reasons:** A medical conclusion issued by a healthcare organization within the state or municipal health system

For military service:** A mobilization notice, order, or summons from the military commissariat containing the time and place of dispatch to the place of military service, and a copy of the contract for military service in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, certified in the manner prescribed by law
For other reasons:** Other documents confirming the grounds for leave, if available
The University Director or an authorized official reviews your application and supporting documents within 10 days of receipt
The decision is made within this 10-day period
The leave is formalized by an order issued by the University Director no later than 5 working days from the day the decision to grant the leave is made
While you are on academic leave, your educational relations are suspended
You are released from obligations related to studying at the University and are not allowed to participate in the educational process until the leave ends
If you study under a contract, you are not charged tuition fees during the academic leave
Academic leave ends when the granted period expires
You may also end it early by submitting a personal application
If you return early, you are admitted to studies based on an order from the University Director
If the leave ends naturally, you are admitted to studies based on an order from the University Director or an authorized official
